baseUrl.description: The base URL of your Confluence Cloud or Server instance. Must be a valid HTTPS URL. Example: https://your-company.atlassian.net

username.description: The email address or username associated with the Confluence account used for authentication

apiKey.description: The API token or password for Confluence authentication. For Cloud instances, use an API token; for Server instances, use the account password

spaceId.description: The Confluence space key or ID to synchronize. All pages within this space will be included unless explicitly excluded

enabled.description: List of Confluence page IDs that should be included in the synchronization

disabled.description: List of Confluence page IDs that should be explicitly excluded from the synchronization

nangoConnectionId.description: The Nango integration connection ID for Google Drive. This establishes the OAuth connection to access the Drive account

enabled.description: List of Google Drive folder IDs that should be included in the synchronization

disabled.description: List of Google Drive folder IDs that should be explicitly excluded from the synchronization

urls.description: Starting page URLs of the website to index. Must be https and resolve to a public address. The v1 console configures exactly one, but the field is a list so additional starting points can be added without a breaking change

maxPages.description: Upper bound on how many pages may be selected for indexing. Server-side limits still apply and take precedence

enabled.description: Absolute page URLs that should be fetched and indexed. These are the pages the user selected from the discovery result, and the complete set: anything absent is not indexed

title.description: Display title of the document used in search results and UI. Can differ from originalName. Examples: 'Product Installation Guide', 'API Documentation'. Length: 2-100 characters

originalFormat.description: File format/extension of the original document for reference. Examples: 'pdf', 'docx', 'md', 'html', 'txt'. Helps identify source document type

originalName.description: Original filename or identifier of the source document. Preserves the source document name. Examples: 'product-knowledge-base.pdf', 'installation-guide.docx'

originalId.description: Original ID from the source system, preserving the reference to the source document. Examples: 'confluence-page-1234567890' (for Confluence), 'gdrive-file-abc123' (for Google Drive), sha1(original-file-content) (for file uploads)

metadata.description: Additional metadata of the document. Example: `{ 'createdAt': '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z', 'updatedAt': '2025-05-01T00:00:00Z', 'createdBy': 'user@example.com' }`

name.description: Descriptive name for the knowledge base. Used for identification in the UI and APIs. Examples: 'Product Knowledge Base', 'Support Documentation'. Length: 2-100 characters

post.description:
Query a knowledge base by its ID and return the answer from the LLM

### Allowed Auth Scopes

- kb:GenerateSearchAnswer
- kb:read

parameters.name: company

schema.description: The unique identifier of the tenant when a service token is used.

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tenant when a service token is used.

searchQuery.description: The question or query to be answered using the knowledge base. The LLM will search the knowledge base and generate an answer based on found results. Example: 'What is the product knowledge base?'

chunkId.description: The ID of the chunk. Example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000

dataSourceId.description: Unique identifier of the data source

score.description: The total score of the result, calculated from the semantic search score and the full-text search score.

fullTextScore.description: The score of the result, calculated from the full-text bm25 search score.

semanticScore.description: The score of the result, calculated from the semantic vector search score.

documentHierarchy.description: The hierarchy of the document. The hierarchy is a list of document IDs that are the parents of the current document. The hierarchy is used to build the document hierarchy in the search results.

searchResults.description: The search results to be used to generate the answer. The LLM will use the search results to generate an answer based on the found results.

model.description: The specific provider and model identifier. Examples: 'openai://gpt-4o' or 'openai://gpt-4o-mini' for OpenAI, 'mistral://mistral-small-2506' for Mistral. Check provider documentation for available models

temperature.description: Controls answer randomness and creativity (0.0-1.0). Low values (0.0-0.3) produce consistent, deterministic answers. High values (0.7-1.0) produce more diverse and creative responses. Defaults to 0.3 for factual consistency

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in the generated answer (1-10000). Higher values allow longer, more detailed answers. Lower values force concise responses. Defaults to 1000 tokens. Note: higher values increase latency and cost

systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt to customize LLM behavior and context. Sets instructions for how the LLM should answer questions. Example: 'You are a helpful technical support assistant. Answer only based on the provided knowledge base. If information is not found, say "I don't have this information in the knowledge base."'
